action.objective: Verify g5f6 (the reserved broad-search suggestion) at max depth: it captures the f6 knight with the g5 bishop, restoring material balance and using the recent h6 pawn attack as the excuse to trade.

Verify at depth 4 with the reserved 2000-node allowance.
